title: The Longest-Tenured Player on Every NFL Roster Entering 2026

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The Longest-Tenured Player on Every NFL Roster Entering 2026
sources.description: Sticking around on a team a long time doesn’t inherently mean a player is good. Maybe they’re just good enough to fill a role. Maybe the team can’t find someone it likes better, even if the player himself isn’t great.…
